mainEntity.name: What types of compensation can I seek after a dog bite in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: In San Diego, you may be able to seek compensation for various damages resulting from a dog bite. This can include economic damages such as medical expenses (hospital visits, surgeries, medications, therapy), lost wages, and future loss of earning capacity if your injuries impact your ability to work. Non-economic damages may also be pursued, which cover pain and suffering, emotional distress, disfigurement, and loss of enjoyment of life. The specific compensation depends on the severity of your injuries and the circumstances of the incident.
